svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Establish authoritative physical outcome by verifying execution evidence against the approved CompletionSpecification and requirement/change versions.
Numbering, naming and event linkage corrected.
Items marked FIXED changed in this edition.
New planning except explicit remediation/reality callbacks
Receive submission from L10; 'Done' is only a submission signal.
For each TaskBlock compare actuals to CompletionSpecification success
Record TaskBlock completion: verified complete / partial /
Evaluate JobOrder completion eligibility across contracted scope and
Customer acknowledgement is evidence; non-response cannot leave job
indefinitely open when objective evidence suffices.
If new physical fact appears, call 09A.
If economic responsibility issue exists, call 09B.
Publish VerifiedActuals/SettlementInput directly to L12 for normal
Close JobOrder only when contracted scope + approved changes satisfy
closure policy; WorkCase may remain open for branches.
No AI-only authority for hard completion criteria
CompletionSpecification is the central success authority.
Customer acceptance is evidence, not sole authority.
Blocked execution is not automatically a terminal outcome.
Cancelled is final only when L7 finalizes cancellation.
Actual cost facts are not automatically customer charges.
Recovered 2026-08-23 from "Layer 11 Outcome Truth Architecture.png" — a
version 1.2 board dated 2026-08-19 that appears in NEITHER the
package nor the v2.1 reconciliation evidence. It exists only in the figma
folder. No other document in the architecture carries this state machine.
S0 RECEIVED — submission received from Layer 10
S1 UNDER REVIEW (AUTO) — validation and reconciliation in progress
S2 COMPLETE — all TaskBlocks completed successfully
S3 PARTIAL — some completed, some not (defined)
S4 BLOCKED (UNAVOIDABLE) — could not proceed further
S5 CANCELLED (BY POLICY) — cancelled via Layer 07 decision
S6 DISPUTED — outcome contested / needs review
S7 FAILED — execution failure / no deliverable
S8 LOCKED (FINAL) — outcome immutable and published
Any -> S5 on cancellation from L07
Any -> S5 is the formal expression of L7's invariant that cancellation
remains requestable at every stage. It is the only place in the
where that invariant is made mechanical rather than stated in prose.
Outcome is based on facts, not opinions
Outcome cannot be edited, only appended
Every outcome has OutcomeReason and timestamp
All links and decisions are traceable
OR-COMPLETE — All Work Completed — all TaskBlocks done as planned —
e.g. IKEA table delivered and old table removed
OR-PARTIAL — Partial Completion — some done, some pending — e.g. 12
OR-BLOCKED — Blocked / Unavoidable — could not proceed further — e.g.
OR-CANCELLED — Cancelled by Policy — cancelled via Layer 07 — e.g.
OR-DISPUTED — Disputed — outcome contested — e.g. customer claims
OR-FAILED — Execution Failure — work could not be executed — e.g.
OR-OTHER — Other — other defined reason — e.g. weather stopped work
LedgerInstruction (12), only after outcomes and responsibility are
L11-G1 · Completed installation fails completion criterion ->
L11-G2 · Customer unavailable but evidence proves completion
L11-G3 · Follow-up suggestion does not keep JobOrder open
Board regenerated from the corrected canonical set. Text is real SVG text — readable by script, not only by eye.
Every consumed event on this board has exactly one producer, or is declared external. Open rulings are listed in the canonical file, not decided here.
